question: What is the meaning of expected lifespan and expected end-condition under defined conditions of use in relation to object characteristics (objective registered data related to circularity)?
data_group: object characteristics (objective registered data related to circularity)
data_point: expected lifespan and expected end-condition under defined conditions of use
description: The expected lifespan (CIUse) refers to the anticipated duration a product will function compared to the average lifespan of similar products in the same application. The expected end-condition (CIEnd of Life) represents the proportion of waste materials to reusable or recyclable materials produced when a building is refurbished or demolished. Both indicators are calculated based on the product's characteristics and are used to assess the sustainability and circularity of the product. These indicators are linked to the product's characteristics and are used to evaluate the product's performance in terms of circularity and sustainability.
